title: Insurance claim settlement bundle
description: Proof of loss, adjuster review, and denial communication for governed claim settlement.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: insurance-claim-settlement
  title: Insurance claim settlement bundle
  description: Proof of loss, adjuster review, and denial communication for governed claim settlement.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-insr-02
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/insurance
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs: [insurance_claim.claim_number, coverage.coverage_analysis, claim_adjustment.recommended_reserve, claim_adjustment.recommended_payment]
      relationshipIds: [arises_from, evaluated_as, contains]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/insurance/proof_of_loss, role: completion }
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/insurance/claims_adjuster_report, role: review }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/insurance/insurance_claim_denial_letter, role: supporting }
